issues.detail: The Greek 'καλον' (kalon) is an adjective modifying 'ανθρωπω γυναικος' (man of woman), but the Vietnamese structure 'người nam không đụng đến người nữ là điều tốt' turns it into a general moral statement ('it is good that men do not touch women') rather than describing the specific type of man/relationship mentioned in the text.
The Greek 'μη απτεσθαι' (not to touch) is an infinitive following 'καλον', but the Vietnamese phrasing loses the specific grammatical connection that defines the nature of the 'man' being described.
